text:
tom: Heads-up: EU ingest emitted a burst of 2-4h late events this morning, recompute queue doubled and we're seeing p95 token latency creep on shared pools. Need a quick plan to protect live API. cc @rob @elaine

ingest-bot: ALERT: shard=eu-central lag=10800 count=980 sample_keys=***

rob: Short-term: admission control + soft-downgrade. Add `admission_hint=background_ok` to internal API and have scheduler admit only if region_background_tokens + job.tokens <= region_background_budget. Otherwise return suggested_action=downgrade.

elaine: UX: expose a checkbox in targeted-replay modal: "Prefer background reserved pool if available" with inline cost + wait estimate. If scheduler suggests downgrade show a pill: "Scheduled as passive to protect live traffic."

rob: Also add `precheck.dedupe=true` option so scheduler runs a tiny sample-key check and skips already-applied keys. Saves tokens on obvious duplicates.

ops: Telemetry + billing asks: please add tags `replay.routing.admission` (background|passive|downgraded), `replay.precheck.dedupe_rate`. Billing should still count tokens normally even if lane changes. I'll need a quota request for a 2h canary if we want reserved capacity.

tom: Example API curl to opt-in tenants:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/replays \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"example","window":"2h","admission_hint":"background_ok","precheck.dedupe":true}'
```
Scheduler should return either `accepted: true` + cost_estimate or `accepted:false` + `suggested_action:downgrade`.

console-bot: Scheduler cost_estimate format expected by console: `{"tokens":"900000","est_cost":"$12.50","wait_ms_p50":"180000"}`. Console will render cost/wait and show downgrade pill if suggested.

rob: Safety rules: 1) region_background_budget default=5_000_000 tokens. 2) if api_p95 > 2x baseline OR shared_queue_depth > 4k then auto-throttle new background admissions by 50% and return suggested_action=downgrade. 3) if precheck.dedupe skip_rate > 30% consider increasing background_budget.

elaine: UX copy draft for tooltip: "Background rehydrates use reserved capacity when available; may reduce wait time but consume reserved quota. Can be preempted or downgraded to passive to protect live traffic. Click to request quota."

ops: I'll file quota request for canary with rb-tool: `rb-tool quota request --tenant example --pool dedicated-eu --tokens 1000000 --hours 2` and post ticket here. We'll monitor SLOs and token burn.

tom: Plan: 1) implement `admission_hint` + precheck in scheduler behind ff, 2) console checkbox behind ff (elaine), 3) staging canary with one tenant 2h, 4) monitor p95, dedupe_rate, token burn, then iterate. Rollback if regressions.

ops: noted. Monitoring team on standby. Ping #eng-oncall for emergency rollback.

rob: I'll draft a small RFC to codify admission thresholds and telemetry tags so ops can tune budgets per-region.

elaine: I'll open the console PR and include the checkbox + pill + tooltip. Tagging this thread in the PR.

tom: Thanks all. Posting results after the canary. :thumbsup:
